title: 第218章 乱了佛门彻底乱了弟子叛变第217章 我为我佛代言
content_zh:
一众弟子一起呐喊，发出的动静比较大，金刚佛子听到了这些口号，脸色都黑了。
那张脸彻底拉下来，他可不想让这种事情发生，这些话语若是让师父他们听到了之后，会怎么想？会如何看待自己，小小的事情都无法解决，还要带来巨大的麻烦，师父肯定不会让他好过的。
这不是重点，重点其他的佛祖看到这一幕，会如何想？又会如何嘲讽他？
自己师父肯定会被其他佛祖嘲讽，灵心佛子一直盯着自己，他肯定在看自己的行动，自己失败了，岂不是？
想到这里，金刚佛子直接动手，朝着那些弟子动手，既然都选择了黑化，选择了坠入魔道，那么，都去死吧，这些弟子没有了存在的价值，当他们选择黑化那一刻，就注定了死亡。
“你们胆敢坠入魔道，那么，都去死吧。”
金刚佛子无法震慑枯土尊者，无法立刻杀死他，但是他可以杀死那些该死的弟子，他们胆敢学习枯土尊者他们叛变，就要承受相应的代价，这代价很大，不是他们可以接受。
于是乎，金刚佛子开始了屠杀黑化的弟子，凡是坠入魔道之人，都该死。
一番杀戮过后，地上多了很多尸体，那些弟子都是自己人，最后成为了敌人，金刚佛子满手鲜血，双眸血红盯着枯土尊者，那股杀意凝聚成了实质，恨不得撕碎他们三个。
“大刚灭菩萨，清明菩萨，赶紧动手杀了他们，不能继续留着他们三个。”
“不仅仅是他们三个，他们背后那一尊假佛，也该死。”
大刚灭菩萨当做没听到，继续老样子，没有立刻动手，也没有选择下死手，而是自顾自战斗，和幽尘行者的默契战斗，彼此都不下死手，都知道对方想要什么，也希望对方给力一点，可以干掉……金刚佛子。
清明菩萨也是一样的想法，她自然不能够和大刚灭菩萨一样，还是要演真一点。
都是演戏，真假的问题罢了，金刚佛子看到这一幕，那张脸更加黑了，他无法指使两人，也无法让他们听从自己的命令，之前，他们两个还会演戏一下，现在，演戏都不演了。
可能是彼此之间的那种默契消失了，被点破了，他们之间的隔阂变大了。
金刚佛子很清楚，这些菩萨对他的意见很大，特别是清明菩萨，这位菩萨才是意见最大的人，只是她一直没有说出来而已，金刚佛子能够感受到。
“清明菩萨，赶紧动手，杀了他们，本佛子承诺给你的都会给你实现。”金刚佛子着急了，催促两人赶紧动手。
以清明菩萨和大刚灭菩萨的实力，杀死那两人，还是很轻松的。
清明菩萨微笑道：“金刚佛子，贫僧也无能为力，魔焰金刚实力很强，没办法快速解决他。”
大刚灭菩萨也开口：“我这边也是，你那边加快速度，赶紧解决枯土尊者。”

他们的想法很简单，你可以迅速解决掉你的对手，我们不会让自己盯防的人去骚扰你，至于能不能做到，看你的实力，若是你做不到的话，对不起，我们帮不了你。
就差没把我们不听你命令行事四个字放在脸上，所以，你想要指使我们做事，你还差了点。
枯土尊者冷笑道：“金刚佛子，你还不清楚吗？你已经是到了神憎鬼厌的地步，佛门灵山之中，没人会喜欢你，也没人会尊重你。”
“该有的东西，你都没有，你谈何让他人服气？”
“这一点，你比起灵心佛子差远了，真的。”
再一次对比，枯土尊者故意为之，就是为了刺激金刚佛子。
“放屁，本佛子哪里比不上灵心佛子，你乱说。”金刚佛子再次炸了，愤怒出拳。
没有章节的拳法，每一次出拳，都带着愤怒，可惜的是，他的拳头无法碰到了枯土尊者，乱了节奏的金刚佛子，已经逐步没有威胁了。
content_en:
All the disciples shouted together, making a loud noise. When the Vajra Buddha heard these slogans, his face turned dark.
That face was completely pulled down. He didn't want this to happen. What would Master and the others think if they heard these words? How will he view himself? Even small things cannot be solved and will cause huge troubles. Master will definitely not let him have an easy time.
This is not the point. The point is what other Buddhas would think when they saw this scene? How would you mock him?
His master will definitely be ridiculed by other Buddhas. The spiritual Buddha has been staring at him. He must be watching his actions. He has failed, isn't he?
Thinking of this, Vajra Buddha directly took action against those disciples. Since they all chose to become black and fall into the devil's path, then let's all die. These disciples have no value in existence. The moment they choose to become black, they are destined to die.
"You dare to fall into the devil's path, then go to hell."
Vajra Buddha cannot intimidate Lord Kutu and cannot kill him immediately, but he can kill those damn disciples. If they dare to imitate Lord Kutu and rebel, they will have to bear the corresponding price. This price is very high and they cannot accept it.
Ever since, Vajra Buddha began to massacre the blackened disciples. Anyone who fell into the devil's path should die.
After the killing, there were many corpses on the ground. Those disciples were all their own, and finally became enemies. Vajra Buddha's hands were full of blood, and his blood-red eyes stared at Lord Kutu. The murderous intention condensed into substance, and he wanted to tear the three of them into pieces.
"Dagangji Bodhisattva and Qingming Bodhisattva, kill them quickly. We can't keep the three of them."
"Not only the three of them, but also the fake Buddha behind them deserves death."
Dagongni Bodhisattva pretended not to hear it, and continued as usual. He did not take action immediately, nor did he choose to take a fatal blow. Instead, he fought on his own. He fought with the tacit understanding of Youchen Walker. Neither of them made a fatal move. They both knew what the other wanted and hoped that the other would be more powerful to kill... Vajra Buddha.
Qingming Bodhisattva has the same idea. Naturally, she cannot be the same as Mahavatar Bodhisattva, so she still has to act more realistically.
It's all acting, it's just a matter of authenticity. When King Kong Buddha saw this scene, his face became even darker. He couldn't instruct the two of them, nor could he make them obey his orders. Before, the two of them would act for a while, but now they don't act.
Maybe the tacit understanding between them disappeared and was broken, and the gap between them became wider.
Vajra Buddha knows very well that these Bodhisattvas have great opinions on him, especially Qingming Bodhisattva. This Bodhisattva is the one with the biggest opinions, but she has never said it out loud. Vajra Buddha can feel it.
"Qingming Bodhisattva, take action quickly and kill them. What this Buddha promised you will be fulfilled." Vajra Buddha became anxious and urged the two of them to take action.
With the strength of Qingming Bodhisattva and Dagongjie Bodhisattva, it was very easy to kill those two people.
Qingming Bodhisattva smiled and said: "Vajra Buddha, the poor monk can't do anything. The Demon Flame Vajra is very powerful, there is no way to quickly deal with him."
Bodhisattva Dagongannie also spoke: "The same goes for me here, speed up your speed and deal with Lord Kutu as soon as possible."
Their idea is very simple, you can quickly deal with your opponent, and we will not let the people we are watching harass you. As for whether you can do it, it depends on your strength. If you can't do it, I'm sorry, we can't help you.
It's just that we don't act according to your orders, so if you want to instruct us to do things, you're still a little short of that.
Venerable Kutu sneered: "Vajra Buddha, don't you know it yet? You have reached the point where gods and ghosts hate you. No one in the Buddhist spiritual mountain will like you, and no one will respect you."
"You don't have what you should have, so how can you let othersConvinced? "
"In this regard, you are far behind Lingxin Buddha, really. "
Comparing it again, Venerable Kutu did it deliberately just to stimulate Vajra Buddha.
"Fart, this Buddha is no better than the spiritual Buddha, you are talking nonsense. "Vajra Buddha exploded again and punched in anger.
There is no boxing technique, and every punch is filled with anger. Unfortunately, his fist cannot touch Lord Kutu, and the Vajra Buddha who has lost his rhythm is gradually no longer a threat.
